# Overview

Exports the four rungs of the destabilised length ladder built in
`17_pest_hibit_ladder.Rmd` as plain ORFs, for import into Benchling:

```
3xFLAG - W - PEST - W - hiBIT                                   294 nt
3xFLAG - W - 1xGFP - W - PEST - W - hiBIT                     1,053 nt
3xFLAG - W - 2xGFP - W - PEST - W - hiBIT                     1,812 nt
3xFLAG - W - 3xGFP - W - PEST - W - hiBIT                     2,571 nt   (W = Waldo linker)
```

**No cloning sequence is added here.** Vector backbone, homology arms and any
assembly junctions are added in Benchling. What leaves this notebook is the
coding sequence and nothing else, so whatever is pasted around it in Benchling
is the only thing that can change it.

**This notebook does not design sequence either.** Every base comes from `17_`'s
exported CSV; the job here is to verify those ORFs are intact and reformat them.
The firefly luc+PEST normaliser in that CSV is **dropped** - it is not a member
of the length series (different vector UTRs, a non-human ORF and 2.8x the CDS
length), so it is cloned on its own terms, not as a fifth rung.

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(Biostrings)

source(here("code", "cds_reporter_design", "reporter_helpers.R"))
```

# 1. Read the ladder sequences

`cds_ordered` is the full ORF **including the terminal stop codon** - that is
the sequence to synthesise, and it is what gets exported. `cds_sense` is the
same ORF without the stop and is what the length and GC columns in `17_`
describe.

```{r read_ladder}
seq_path <- here("output", "cds_reporter_design", params$sequences_csv)
stopifnot("Notebook 17 sequence CSV not found - knit 17_pest_hibit_ladder.Rmd first" =
            file.exists(seq_path))

ladder_all <- read_csv(seq_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

expected_cols <- c("construct", "gfp_copies", "n_waldo", "ecori", "cds_length",
                   "nt_ordered", "protein_aa", "gc_pct", "gc3_pct",
                   "cds_ordered", "cds_sense")
stopifnot(all(expected_cols %in% colnames(ladder_all)))

# The firefly normaliser is the one row with no eGFP copy count.
ladder <- ladder_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(gfp_copies)) %>%
  mutate(gfp_copies = as.integer(gfp_copies)) %>%
  arrange(gfp_copies)

stopifnot(
  "Expected exactly four ladder rungs after dropping firefly" = nrow(ladder) == 4,
  "Rungs are not 0-3 eGFP copies" = identical(ladder$gfp_copies, 0:3),
  "Firefly was not present to drop - check the input CSV" =
    nrow(ladder_all) == nrow(ladder) + 1
)

ladder %>%
  dplyr::select(construct, gfp_copies, cds_length, nt_ordered, protein_aa,
                gc_pct, gc3_pct, ecori) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.double), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% print(row.names = FALSE)
```

# 2. Verify the ORFs

These re-derive from the bases themselves rather than trusting `17_`'s columns,
so a wrong file or a mangled column is caught here and not at the bench.

```{r validate_orfs}
orf <- ladder$cds_ordered
names(orf) <- ladder$construct

stopifnot(
  "An ORF contains a character other than A/C/G/T" =
    all(str_detect(orf, "^[ACGT]+$")),
  "An ORF does not start with ATG" = all(str_starts(orf, "ATG")),
  "An ORF length is not a multiple of 3" = all(nchar(orf) %% 3 == 0),
  "An ORF length disagrees with the recorded nt_ordered" =
    all(nchar(orf) == ladder$nt_ordered),
  "nt_ordered is not cds_length + one stop codon" =
    all(ladder$nt_ordered == ladder$cds_length + 3),
  "cds_sense is not cds_ordered minus the stop" =
    all(substr(orf, 1, ladder$cds_length) == ladder$cds_sense)
)

# Translation: exactly one stop, and it is the last residue.
prot <- map_chr(orf, ~ as.character(Biostrings::translate(Biostrings::DNAString(.x))))

stopifnot(
  "An ORF does not end in a stop codon" = all(str_ends(prot, "\\*")),
  "An ORF carries an internal stop codon" = all(str_count(prot, "\\*") == 1),
  "Translated length disagrees with the recorded protein_aa" =
    all(nchar(prot) - 1 == ladder$protein_aa),
  "EcoRI site count does not match the pinned Waldo linker count" =
    all(str_count(orf, "GAATTC") == ladder$ecori)
)
```

The peptide-level spot-checks need the identity of each part. Those constants
are **imported from the same spreadsheet `17_` built the constructs from and
translated here**, never retyped - a transcription error in a reference peptide
would make the check agree with itself and pass on a wrong construct.

```{r validate_parts}
parts_xlsx <- here("accessories", "cds seq.xlsx")
stopifnot("accessories/cds seq.xlsx not found" = file.exists(parts_xlsx))

# Same parse as 17_, so the two notebooks cannot read the sheet differently.
parts_tbl <- read_excel(parts_xlsx)
names(parts_tbl)[1] <- "construct"
parts_in <- parts_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(construct), !is.na(cds)) %>%
  transmute(part = tolower(str_trim(construct)),
            seq  = toupper(gsub("\\s", "", cds)))
stopifnot("Duplicate part names in cds seq.xlsx" = !any(duplicated(parts_in$part)))
pseq <- setNames(parts_in$seq, parts_in$part)

checked <- c("hibit", "flag3x", "hpest")
stopifnot(
  "cds seq.xlsx is missing a part this notebook checks" =
    all(checked %in% names(pseq)),
  "A checked part contains non-ACGT characters" =
    all(!grepl("[^ACGT]", pseq[checked])),
  "A checked part is not divisible by 3" =
    all(nchar(pseq[checked]) %% 3 == 0)
)

aa_of     <- function(s) as.character(Biostrings::translate(Biostrings::DNAString(s)))
hibit_aa  <- aa_of(pseq[["hibit"]])
flag3x_aa <- aa_of(pseq[["flag3x"]])
hpest_aa  <- aa_of(pseq[["hpest"]])

# The degron part and reporter_helpers.R's PEST_AA must be the same 40-mer; if
# they drift apart the firefly normaliser no longer carries the ladder's degron.
stopifnot(
  "The hpest part does not match PEST_AA in reporter_helpers.R" =
    hpest_aa == PEST_AA
)

stopifnot(
  "A rung does not begin with Met followed by the 3xFLAG peptide" =
    all(substr(prot, 2, 1 + nchar(flag3x_aa)) == flag3x_aa),
  "A rung does not end with the HiBiT peptide" =
    all(str_ends(prot, fixed(paste0(hibit_aa, "*")))),
  "HiBiT appears more than once in a rung" =
    all(str_count(prot, fixed(hibit_aa)) == 1),
  "A rung is missing the PEST degron" =
    all(str_detect(prot, fixed(hpest_aa))),
  "The PEST degron appears more than once in a rung" =
    all(str_count(prot, fixed(hpest_aa)) == 1)
)

# Independent length reconstruction from 17_'s own part table: the parts of a
# rung plus one stop codon must account for every base of its ORF.
parts_path <- here("output", "cds_reporter_design",
                   str_replace(params$sequences_csv, "_sequences_", "_parts_"))
stopifnot("Notebook 17 parts CSV not found" = file.exists(parts_path))

part_sums <- read_csv(parts_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(construct) %>% summarise(parts_nt = sum(nt), .groups = "drop")

chk <- ladder %>% dplyr::select(construct, nt_ordered) %>%
  left_join(part_sums, by = "construct")
stopifnot(
  "A rung has no matching row in the parts table" = !any(is.na(chk$parts_nt)),
  "Parts plus one stop codon do not reconstruct the ORF length" =
    all(chk$parts_nt + 3 == chk$nt_ordered)
)

cat("4/4 ORFs verified: ATG start, single terminal stop, 3xFLAG head,",
    "single PEST degron,\nterminal HiBiT, EcoRI count pinned to the linker",
    "count, and part lengths reconstruct every ORF.\n")
```

# 3. Name and export

```{r build_export}
design <- ladder %>%
  mutate(
    # A construct id must not contain whitespace: downstream tools write and
    # re-read files named after it, and a space silently breaks that round trip.
    construct_id = str_replace_all(construct, "[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_"),
    seq_name     = paste(params$export_tag, construct_id, sep = "_")
  )

stopifnot(
  "A sequence name contains whitespace" = !any(str_detect(design$seq_name, "\\s")),
  "Sequence names are not unique" = !any(duplicated(design$seq_name))
)

benchling <- design %>%
  transmute(
    Name        = seq_name,
    Bases       = cds_ordered,
    Description = sprintf(
      "%s; %d eGFP cop%s; %d nt ORF incl. stop; %d aa; GC %.1f%%, GC3 %.1f%%; %d EcoRI (Waldo linkers); from 17_pest_hibit_ladder; backbone and homology arms NOT included",
      construct, gfp_copies, ifelse(gfp_copies == 1, "y", "ies"), nt_ordered, protein_aa, gc_pct, gc3_pct, ecori)
  )

as.data.frame(benchling %>% mutate(Bases = paste0(substr(Bases, 1, 24), "...")) ) %>%
  print(row.names = FALSE)
```

Two files, both under `output/cds_reporter_design/`. The CSV is for Benchling's
bulk DNA-sequence import (`Name` / `Bases` / `Description`); the FASTA is for
drag-and-drop import, whichever route is less friction.

```{r export}
outdir <- here("output", "cds_reporter_design")
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
tag <- params$export_tag

csv_path <- file.path(outdir, paste0("21_benchling_import_", tag, ".csv"))
write_csv(benchling, csv_path)

fasta_path <- file.path(outdir, paste0("21_length_reporter_orfs_", tag, ".fasta"))
Biostrings::writeXStringSet(
  Biostrings::DNAStringSet(setNames(design$cds_ordered, design$seq_name)),
  fasta_path)

# Round trip: both files on disk must give back exactly the ORFs verified above.
rt_fa  <- Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(fasta_path)
rt_csv <- read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot(
  "FASTA round trip does not reproduce the ORFs" =
    identical(as.character(rt_fa), setNames(design$cds_ordered, design$seq_name)),
  "CSV round trip does not reproduce the ORFs" =
    identical(rt_csv$Bases, design$cds_ordered),
  "CSV round trip does not reproduce the names" =
    identical(rt_csv$Name, design$seq_name)
)

cat("Wrote:\n ", csv_path, "\n ", fasta_path, "\n")
```
